releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.42 — the Friends tab tells the truth, and keeps its people. The friend graph was the only list in the app with no local copy: one failed or half-read /friends answer and the tab went back to "No friends yet" even though the Chats tab was showing the same people from its cache. It is now cached on disk like the chats, a failed load can no longer delete the friends it failed to re-confirm, a row the server lists is never dropped just because its profile came back empty, and — the one that actually matters — your chat list and your friend list are reconciled, so anyone you have a 1:1 conversation with appears in Friends. The empty state no longer guesses: it says whether the request failed, whether the server answered zero friends, or whether the rows could not be read.
